svg.text: Every model that differed on any input differed on #16
Where each of the 16 model predictions differed from the local program’s output (20 inputs)
Run on: UoB OneChat (University of Birmingham bAI platform), except DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Doubao 2.1 Lite, which were run in the Doubao app.
(dashed line: nine models differed on nothing, seven differed)
The inputs where any model differed:
“a car door with a rear view mirror”
“the cat turned away from the camera”
“shot from the camera behind the cat”
#16: seven models predicted θ 135 (three-quarter rear); the program printed θ 180 because “rear view” was matched first.
This is not accuracy and not a ranking, and it does not say which side was right.
